notes: The Recreation and Park Commission's 1958 volume. Curated: contracts for Washington Square, Hayes Valley, the Lake Merced Sports Center and Cayuga, the Conservatory's rehabilitation architect, and the Balboa Park pool's opening.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the Portola Playground and field house alterations (Res. 3276, Arntz Construction Co., $156,600, September 11), because it is unclear which present page that playground is; the corporation yard (Payne Construction, $165,123) and the Golden Gate Park handball courts (Clovis Construction, $47,716), which have no page.
